newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: RTRS-Saudi traders seek rice from U.S., Australia - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Saudi traders seek rice from U.S., Australia - paper.

text.p: Saudi Arabian traders are seeking to buy rice from the United States, Australia and Ecuador after a 30 percent increase in Indian and Pakistani rice prices, a Saudi newspaper said on Monday.

"Because of the increase in (imported) rice prices from India and Pakistan, some types of rice were not being imported," al-Ayam said. "A number of Saudi traders are seeking rice from other sources mainly the United States, Equador and Australia."
It quoted Saudi importers as saying the prices of rice from India rose 30 percent in the past three months.
Saudi Arabia imports around 700,000 tonnes of rice a year mainly from India, the United States, Thailand and Pakistan at a cost of around three billion riyals ($800 million).
